scope: Existing out-of-fold predictions on development rows, regrouped by alloy family. No refitting and no final-query evaluation. Predictions predate the reviewed-composition pipeline migration.
metric: Unweighted mean within-family, within-fold Spearman; constant predictions/targets score zero as in the original evaluation. Folds with no members of a family are absent, not scored.
constant_correlation_policy: Undefined correlations from constant values were scored as zero, matching scripts/epit_pipeline/calibrate_target_rules.py.
limitation: The nine selected Fe/Ni-Cr-Mo formulas have no saved out-of-fold predictions on Al, HEA or Other. These missing combinations are not zero scores.
